Package com.example.eventflow.model.entities

Class Profile

java.lang.Object
com.example.eventflow.model.entities.Profile
public class Profile extends Object
Model class representing a user profile within the application. Stores personal information, interests, availability, and application settings. This profile is linked to a Firebase Auth UID.
